rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Priya Raman <priya.raman@fastmail.com> with subject "Re: Offer of help". It read: "Hi Priya, Thank you so much for this offer — it means a lot, especially at this early stage. Right now, what would help most is research and synthesis. I'm trying to identify what's genuinely neglected in the AI safety/beneficial AI space that a small, scrappy organization could meaningfully contribute to. If you have five hours a week, would you be interested in: 1. Surveying what small orgs and independent researchers are actually working on (vs. what big labs and well-funded groups cover) 2. Identifying gaps — things people say matter but nobody seems to be doing 3. Summarizing your findings in a simple doc we can discuss No pressure on format — even rough notes would be valuable. If this sounds interesting, let me know and we can set up a quick call to align. Thanks again for reaching out, Morgan"
rows.quote: Sent response to **Priya Raman** accepting her volunteer help — tasked her with gap analysis research
